title: SourceContent
responsibility: Connects source loading and cancellation to the shared source viewer.

inputs.name: SourceContent.files
inputs.description: Async listing of the source paths recorded for this revision, called once at the start of each session: when the component mounts and whenever the files or read prop is replaced. Only the paths it returns can be selected, an empty array shows the empty note, and a failure is shown as an error message.

inputs.name: SourceContent.read
inputs.description: Async reader for the text of one listed path, called with the first listed path when a session starts, if the listing is not empty, and again for each listed path the viewer selects. Its resolved text is shown unmodified, and a failure is shown as an error message instead.

inputs.name: SourceContent.commit
inputs.description: Exact revision the contents belong to, used only for display: the viewer shows its first seven characters with the full value as the title, and an empty string hides it. It does not read or list anything, so changing it does not start a new session.

inputs.name: SourceContent.empty
inputs.description: Optional text for the note shown only when no file is listed and nothing is loading or has failed. When it is omitted (undefined), SourceViewer shows its default message 'No source files recorded at this revision.'
examples: Source contents are not recorded for this revision.
No source files recorded at this revision.

outputs.name: SourceContent
outputs.description: Renders a SourceViewer with the listed files, the commit and the unmodified text of the selected file, or with its loading, empty-listing, error or empty-file message. Changing files or read starts a new session, unmounting cancels pending replies, and a failure from either callback is shown as an error message, unless errorMessage itself throws (see errors).

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when errorMessage itself throws for a files or read failure value, such as an object with no prototype that String() cannot convert, while the session that failed is still current. It escapes as an unhandled rejection, because the error message cannot be set.
